g.text: Spawn map updated - B now selectable on deploy
Icons recolor by owner: blue BLUFOR, orange
OPFOR, grey neutral. Timer counts remaining.
Teams start at 300. Minority hold bleeds 1/5 s;
zero CPs bleeds 1/2 s. First team to zero loses.
Grouped by squad, leader starred. Columns:
score, K/D, revives - teamwork scores visibly.
Flag B flips to BLUFOR: toast announces the new
spawn option and the deploy map recolors live.
OPFOR bleeds -12/min (1 ticket/5 s) while BLUFOR
holds 3 of 5 flags - majority forces the bleed.
Hold Tab (desktop) or tap scores (mobile) to
show; gameplay continues behind the overlay.
